phase_name: Roadmap Entries Accessor and Next-Batch Reader

objectives.description: Create `scripts/lib/roadmap-entries-lib.sh` (sourced, sets no shell options, never exits): a function emitting batches of non-closed milestones in milestone-the
Create `scripts/tests/test-roadmap-entries-lib.sh`: nested order, closed milestone skipped, flat fallback, both shapes present (nested wins), empty store, outpu
Change `orchestrate-suggest-next-batch.sh`'s `read_roadmap_batches()` to read through the accessor; behaviour on a flat store is unchanged.
In `test-orchestrate-suggest-next-batch.sh` keep one flat-shape fixture as the fallback case, convert the rest to the nested shape, and add a closed-milestone-i
Register the new lib and suite in `manifest.json` and `suite-classification.data` (class `unit`).

verification_notes:
- Verification Tier full discharged against the SCOPED tier per the dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral; the full gate set is deferred to the batch stage, not run here. verify-touched.sh resolved 38 suites; because it executes the stale deployed copies, the same 38 were run from the source store (run-all.sh --only, CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE=source-store): 34 passed, 4 failed and each was resolved and re-run green except the known-failures entry: test-common-lib (artifact of the env override; green without it), test-manifest-scripts-sync (new files untracked; green once tracked), test-deploy-propagation (a task-reference wording defect in Phase 1's test-validate-state.sh comment; fixed here, green), test-gate-cache-equivalence (known-failures.txt entry; its two named sub-causes were the same task-reference defect plus an SC2034 in the Phase 1 fixture helper, both fixed and confirmed by check-task-references.sh = 0 and shellcheck -S warning clean).
- Suites that resolve subjects deploy-tree-first only exercise source edits under CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE=source-store.
- The accessor emits description LAST in the reader's TSV because tab is IFS whitespace and an empty middle field would shift columns.
